business_problem: Shenqiu County needed a more scalable way to serve a large, mobile population with grassroots public services, because manual consultation, data collection, and work-order routing put too much burden on local staff and made 24-hour service difficult.
solution_summary: Baidu AI Cloud's AppBuilder and ModelBuilder capabilities were used by Wuhan Zhongwei Huitong to create a grassroots-governance service stack for Shenqiu County. On the resident side, the county launched a 'Resident Assistant' across WeChat groups, mini-programs, official accounts, H5 entry points, and personal-assistant style interfaces. AppBuilder's role instructions, speech recognition, online search, standard follow-up prompts, and safety framework help the assistant answer local policy and administrative questions against a county-specific knowledge base. On the government side, the same platform powers Copilot and Insight workflows for local officials. Natural-language understanding converts巡查 or dispute-resolution field notes into structured forms and work orders, while Workflow and GBI capabilities route, review, complete, and evaluate those work orders. The result is a public-service architecture that joins resident self-service, policy knowledge retrieval, voice-to-text information capture, and automated case handling into one county-level service platform.

solution_components.name: AppBuilder
solution_components.role: Drives the resident assistant, local knowledge-base question answering, and government Copilot workflows for Shenqiu's grassroots service scenarios.

solution_components.name: ModelBuilder
solution_components.role: Supports custom-model and component configuration for local administrative workflows and policy-assistant experiences.

solution_components.name: Workflow
solution_components.role: Automates work-order creation, routing, review, feedback, and closure inside government service processes.

solution_components.name: GBI
solution_components.role: Adds insight-oriented analysis capabilities around grassroots government data and service flows.

data_flow: Resident questions enter through WeChat groups, mini-programs, or H5 channels, AppBuilder answers them from the local government knowledge base or via guarded online search, staff voice or text inputs are turned into structured forms and work orders, and Workflow routes cases through review and completion while service data feeds analysis and continuous improvement.
business_outcome: Shenqiu extended public-service reach, sped up resident responses, reduced clerical burden on frontline staff, and improved satisfaction with grassroots government services.
metrics: resident service response speed improved by 30%
architecture_clues: The resident-facing service runs across WeChat groups, mini-programs, official accounts, H5, and assistant-style channels rather than a single app.
The same stack supports both citizen self-service and internal government work-order automation.
Online search is gated by a safety-response framework when local knowledge does not contain a standard answer.
